title: Nagaram Marupakkam
desc: Selvam, a criminal seeking a fresh start in Hyderabad, falls for a dancer. Just as they plan their future, unresolved events from his past resurface, threatening his new life.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Yashoda
desc: Surrogate mother Yashodha is advised to follow a few guidelines to keep herself and her baby healthy and safe. However, something happens at the surrogate centre that puts both of them at risk.

title: Bengal Tiger
desc: Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: Sivanudukkai
desc: A boy becomes an atheist after his parents' death. Unbeknown to him, he is born for a divine purpose and must stop a demon from sacrificing his lover.
